name: universal-format
description: Silently auto-formats just-written Shell, Java, Kotlin, JS/TS, Python and Go files after Write/Edit using each language's standard formatter when installed (shfmt, google-java-format/clang-format, ktlint/ktfmt, prettier/biome, ruff/black, goimports/gofmt); honors .editorconfig and tool-native configs; no-op when the formatter is absent.

auto_format.title: Auto-format on Write/Edit
auto_format.description: Silently format just-written files with each language's standard formatter when it is installed; see the plugin description for the full tool list.
